BACKEND BUG FOUND, and it is why this case says 'no compliant plan'. POST /tools/claims builds the claim with packages/contracts/safe.py:claim_from_result, which reads every field of the answer sheet except 'available' - so every claim filed through that endpoint lands with available=false. policy/rules.deliverable_qty then returns 0 for that supplier, every plan loses its quantity and decide returns zero strategies. Filing a claim at all currently zeroes the case. I have reproduced this case on the fixed code with the identical seeded ERP data and it prices 9 plans; the ranked options follow in the next events, and a PR with the one-line fix plus the review package is on its way.
SUP-KBY answered: free_in_stock, 500,000 pcs at EUR 3.5
